surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Toffoli sparks the Sharks back from two down
paras: Zac Jones, who scores in about 1 game in 22, scored twice. The first period was a wild one. Jones scored his first goal for Utah early in the period to open the scoring, and Mikhail Sergachev made it 2-0 on the power play midway through the period. Tyler Toffoli got the Sharks on the board on the power play less than three minutes later. Jones scored again just over a minute later to make it 3-1 for the Mammoth. San Jose had a goal taken off for offside just 56 seconds into the second. Adam Gaudette pulled the Sharks within one on the power play early in the period, and Zack Ostapchuk tied it 3-3 just six seconds later. Ty Dellandrea and Andrew Peeke fought early in the period. Jack McBain restored the Mammoth’s lead midway through the period. San Jose had another goal taken off for goalie interference later in the period, but it didn’t cost them in the end. Gaudette and Peeke dropped the gloves later in the period. Eric Pohlkamp, in his sixth NHL game, scored his first NHL goal, set up by Macklin Celebrini, early in the third to tie it 4-4. Dmitry Orlov put the Sharks ahead 5-4 with less than six minutes left. Barrett Hayton tied it up for Utah on the power play with less than four minutes left. The shootout went five rounds, and Mason Marchment won it for the Sharks after Celebrini had scored earlier. Orlov finished with four points on a goal and three assists, and the Mammoth’s Kailer Yamamoto had three assists.

The Mammoth outshot the Sharks 32-21, but the Sharks’ looks were better, so the chances came out about even. Yaroslav Askarov made 27 saves for the Sharks, and Karel Vejmelka allowed five goals on 21 shots. The Sharks moved to 9-11-2 and climbed to fourth in the Pacific, while the Mammoth fell to 10-8-3, fifth in the Central.

items.text: The Mammoth are winless in five (0-2-3).
Tyler Toffoli scored again against Utah, and has five goals in seven games against them since 2023-24.
Adam Gaudette scored his first goal of the season, his first since Apr 2 (eleven games played since).

The Mammoth were without Nate Schmidt, John Marino, Nick Schmaltz and others. Taking into account how much value each of these missing players usually adds, only the Avalanche were missing more at the time.
